lines.text: What if circles simply didn't exist?
Your day starts badly. Your alarm clock is a cube, and so is the sun.
Breakfast is a square egg in a square pan, with a mug that has four corners.
Your spoon can never reach the cereal stuck in them.
The town clock is a square, and its hands get stuck in every corner.
So the whole town is always running four minutes late.

segments.caption: Nothing spins
segments.fact: NO GEARS · NO BEARINGS · NO FANS

lines.text: At work, nothing spins. No gears, no ball bearings, no fans.
The factory runs on people sliding boxes around.
Football is chaos. The ball is a cube. It doesn't roll, it tumbles.
The goalkeeper just sits on it.
Lunch is pizza, which is honestly fine.
It always came in a square box anyway.
Then an engineer has an idea. Instead of fixing the wheels, fix the road.
On a road of perfectly shaped bumps, square wheels roll smoothly. And this works in real life.
So life goes on, just with a few more corners.
Which circle would you miss the most?
